title: The World's Billionaires Dataset 1987~2022
hook: Explore the shifting landscape of global wealth across decades.
setup: This animation tracks net worth rankings over time using historical dataset records.

sequence.text: Keizo Saji enters the ranking as a newcomer in 1987.
Bill Gates appears as a newcomer in the 1991 rankings.
Karl and Theo Albrecht experience a dramatic jump in the 1998 rankings.
Alice Walton enters the rankings as a newcomer in 2000.
Larry Ellison appears as a newcomer in the 2005 rankings.

ending: These shifting positions illustrate the dynamic nature of global wealth over time.
